description: Run an Agent402 tool by slug, with params matching that tool's inputSchema; find slugs with catalog.find or catalog.search. The 170 pure-CPU tools run free here, rate-limited, through proof-of-work. Paid tools are payable here over MPP (the challenges ride in _meta). An unknown slug returns an error.

params.description: Tool input, matching the tool's inputSchema

name: catalog.call

outputSchema.description: Envelope around the invoked catalog tool's native JSON result

result.description: Native tool output (shape depends on slug)

title: Run an Agent402 tool
